AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_video_user_video uv WHERE uv.is_deleted = 0 AND uv.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND uv.video_id = v.id AND uv.extract_status = 3 )
AND (v.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.video_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND v.publish_time >= #{publishStartTime}
AND v.publish_time <= #{publishEndTime}
AND v.id < #{cursorId} AND v.id > #{cursorId}
AND (

, v.id) < (#{cursorSortVal}, #{cursorId})
AND (
v.like_count v.comment_count v.share_count v.collect_count v.publish_time v.id
, v.id) > (#{cursorSortVal}, #{cursorId})
ORDER BY
v.like_count v.comment_count v.share_count v.collect_count v.publish_time v.id
DESCASC
, v.id DESCASC
LIMIT #{limit}
